notes: Two separate routes, each naming Al-A'mash in its own text, so separate groups and a null tail
«- هو ابن موسى -» is an editor gloss, left out
«حدثنا أبي» is a bare relation (the father of Muhammad ibn Abi Ubayda)
«وحديث قطبة أتم وأكثر» names another transmitter's fuller version of the same report: a variant group, not a route
